page_plan.detail: Quick win on https://www.example.com/features/online-booking/ (position 14.8): lead the title and H1 with "online booking system" and cover the secondary terms

Quick win on https://www.example.com/industries/salons/ (position 9.4): lead the title and H1 with "salon booking app" and cover the secondary terms. https://www.example.com/blog/salon-booking-tips/ also gets impressions for "salon booking app": keep https://www.example.com/industries/salons/ as the target, and link from the other page to it with the head as the anchor

Upgrade https://www.example.com/ (position 25.1) for "appointment scheduling software": the home page holds this head term, so give it a section on appointment scheduling with the secondary terms and link the feature pages from it

Build a new page targeting "google my business booking button" (/integrations/google-business-profile/ is a better match for "google business profile booking button"). The results page is weak: 6 of 9 organic results are forums and directories and the difficulty is 12

Defend https://www.example.com/blog/appointment-reminder-templates/ (position 2.4): keep it current, add the secondary terms, and link to it from the related pages. Its intent is mixed, so check the results page before changing the page type
